_readme: The ONE catalog of the superbased SDKs (review P-11, first-run plan revision 2 section 3.9, lane C0): one row per language with its package, install lines, published flag, init snippet and setup command. The apps read it through shared/lib/sdkCatalog.ts (web's AI Apps first-run card, web2's Settings > Apps & SDKs facts); the marketing page generator replaces @@sdk.<id>.<field>@@ and @@sdk.languages@@ tokens from it (website/docs-tools/pagegen/sdk.go); scripts/sdk-install-strings.py checks it and flips the published flags on the SDK release. A new language is one more row here and nothing else. `install_checkout` is shown while `published` is false, `install_published` once it is true. `release` names what publishes the row: "sdk-release" is .github/workflows/sdk-release.yml on an sdk-v<x.y.z> tag (sdk-install-strings.py flip sets these rows); "none" means no workflow publishes it yet and the flag is flipped by hand (sdk-install-strings.py flip --sdk <id>). The snippet is the one init line (AI Apps SDK quickstart plan 7): init() names the service after the project, instruments the installed model libraries and sends where setup chose (with nothing set up, to this machine). `setup` is the one-command quickstart (plan 3.5), on the Python and TypeScript rows only; Go and Java users run either with --key-only. The agent prompt is built from it (shared/lib/sdkPrompt.ts; the website partial pages-src/partials/prompt-sdk.html).

sdks.label: Python
sdks.install_checkout: pip install ./sdk/python  # from a checkout: not on PyPI yet

sdks.label: TypeScript
sdks.install_checkout: npm install ./sdk/typescript  # from a checkout: not on npm yet
snippet: // ES modules: run the app with --import @superbased/sdk/register instead

sdks.label: Go
sdks.install_checkout: go mod edit -require=github.com/superbasedapp/observer/sdk/go@v0.0.0 -replace=github.com/superbasedapp/observer/sdk/go=<checkout>/sdk/go && go mod tidy  # from a checkout: not tagged yet

sdks.label: Java
sdks.install_checkout: mvn -q -f ./sdk/java install -DskipTests  # from a checkout: not on Maven Central yet; then depend on app.superbased:superbased-sdk:0.2.0
